t: Kanem–Bornu Empire - Wikipedia
s: 1 week ago - The name Kanem–Bornu Empire (or Kanem–Borno Empire) is a historiographical name used to cover the entire history of the state ruled by the Duguwa, Sayfawa, and al-Kanemi dynasties. Kanem–Bornu was not a native or contemporary name used by the empire. The name is an amalgamation of the two main central regions of the empire over the course of its history: Kanem in modern-day Chad and Bornu (or Borno) in modern-day Nigeria.
